As the task says, I did not run typecheck, lint, vitest or the code-reviewer, because there is no diff. I did not use the browser and did not touch `retros/`, `lessons.md`, `user-review/` or any B file.

My report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-260.md`. It has the three results above and one piece of lesson feedback for B to rule on at the round-261 planning. I agree with the new L11 rule that a spec conflict is a STOP. I suggest it apply only when two task clauses cannot both be met by one change. Of the B acceptance criteria, I claim only §2 items 1–3.
